title: UltraSuite UXTD/UXSSD manually revised reference-label subset
why_promising: Primary child speech production with synchronized ultrasound and audio. UltraSuite exposes a cleanly isolable human-revised subset: speaker labels manually revised for 60 utterances and word-level labels manually revised for 199 utterances by a single annotator; labels are available as Praat TextGrid and HTK lab files. The broader phone layer is explicitly only force-aligned and therefore must not be admitted wholesale.
open_question: Enumerate the downloadable reference-label files and map each human-revised utterance to its audio/ultrasound recording and speaker/task metadata. Admit only the manually revised speaker/word tiers unless a phone tier can be independently shown to have exhaustive human correction; retain the automatic phone tier only as excluded lineage/context.
